db_file.description: Location to read/store ifile database. Defaults to user home directory .idata file.

strip_headers.description: Skip all header lines except Subject:, From: and To:.

use_stemming.description: Use 'Porter' stemming algorithm when lexing documents.

keep_stopwords.description: Do not throw out overly frequent (stoplist) words when lexing.

keep_infrequent.description: Leave in the database words that occur infrequently (normally they are tossed).

use_bitvector.description: Uses document bit-vector representation. Count each word once per document.

max_message_length.description: Ignore portion of message after first char characters. Use entire message if char set to 0.

training_folders.description: List of folder/category names used for training or classification. Must not include space characters.

concise_threshold.description: Threshold for concise output difference (used with -c -q). Output two highest ranking categories if score differs by at most threshold / 1000.

message_source_path.description: Directory path where message files reside for batch processing with ifile.
